beats.text: 列位看官，今日接著說三分——
beats.en: Gentlemen all, today we go on with the Three Kingdoms…

as.guan: 官人來得巧，正說到三分——
as.shi: 相公也愛聽三分？請站前頭。
as.seng: 師父也來聽？今日說三分——

asEn.guan: You've come just in time, sir: the Three Kingdoms…
asEn.shi: You like the Three Kingdoms too, sir? Stand at the front.
asEn.seng: You've come to listen too, Master? The Three Kingdoms…
asEn.fu: This way, madam, there's room at the front.
asEn.tong: Don't push, little one. Stand at the front.
asEn.jun: You too, soldier, for the Three Kingdoms?
asEn.li: Set down your load, brother, and hear a bit.

beats.en: Bravo!
And then what?
More tomorrow.

beats.text: 又來了？今日正說到赤壁。
beats.en: Back again? Today we're at Red Cliff.

as.guan: 官人又來了？今日說赤壁。

asEn.guan: Back again, sir? Today it's Red Cliff.

beats.text: 瓦子裏霍四究說三分，那才叫好。
beats.en: Huo Sijiu tells it in the pleasure grounds. Now that's telling.

beats.text: 他在棚裏，我在街頭，隨意賞。
beats.en: He has a booth; I have the street. Pay what you like.
I'll come again tomorrow!

beats.text: 雜劇、唱曲、傀儡、講史，京城樣樣有。
beats.en: Plays, songs, puppets, histories: the capital has it all.
Nothing beats a good storyteller.
Well told. Here's a few cash for you.
Thank you kindly! Come early tomorrow.

beats.text: 好花苗，栽下去開春就開。
beats.en: Good seedlings. Plant them and they'll bloom this spring.

as.fu: 娘子，好花苗，插在院裏好看。
as.tong: 小哥兒，叫你爹爹買一枝。
as.li: 大哥，帶一枝回家哄娘子。

asEn.guan: Sir, a few seedlings for your house?
asEn.shi: Sir, one to plant by your window?
asEn.fu: Madam, fine seedlings. Lovely in your courtyard.
asEn.seng: Master, one to offer before the Buddha?
asEn.tong: Little one, get your father to buy one.
asEn.li: Brother, take one home to please your wife.

beats.en: How much a sprig?
Three for ten cash. One price.
I want that flower!

beats.text: 城外園子裏剛挖的，帶著土。
beats.en: Dug today in a garden outside the walls, soil and all.

asEn.guan: Look, sir, the soil's still on the roots.

beats.en: Sit still. Don't wriggle.
Daddy, buy the red one!
A sprig for the holiday, for luck.
The tavern door's the best pitch in town.
Drinkers coming out like to take a sprig too.
Flower man, keep two for me.

beats.text: 到了麼？男家的人可來了？
beats.en: Are we there? Has the groom's side come?

as.guan: 這位官人好相貌，可曾婚配？
as.shi: 相公可曾定親？我這裏有好人家。
as.fu: 娘子家裏可有待嫁的姑娘？
as.tong: 小哥兒，等你長大了來找我。
as.seng: 師父莫看，這是說親的轎子。
as.jun: 軍爺讓讓，說親的轎子要落了。
as.li: 大哥讓一讓，轎子要落了。

asEn.guan: What a fine-looking gentleman. Are you married, sir?
asEn.shi: Are you betrothed, young sir? I know a good family.
asEn.fu: Madam, any daughters at home of an age to wed?
asEn.tong: Little one, come and find me when you're grown.
asEn.seng: Don't stare, Master. This chair goes matchmaking.
asEn.jun: Make way, soldier. The matchmaker's chair is setting down.
asEn.li: Step aside, brother. The chair's setting down.

beats.en: This is the Sun Yang wine house. We're here.
Setting down!

beats.text: 這門親事，今日定要說成。
beats.en: This match gets settled today.

beats.text: 前頭轎裏也是媒人，我倆一道。
beats.en: The chair in front holds a matchmaker too. We go in pairs.
Both families are well-to-do.

beats.text: 姑娘家出不得門，全憑我這張嘴。
beats.en: A girl can't go out, so it all rests on my tongue.

beats.text: 瞧我這冠子，新插的絹花。
beats.en: See my crown? Fresh silk flowers.
Carried all the way. My shoulders are swollen.

beats.text: 說成了，少不了你們的賞。
beats.en: Settle it, and there's a tip for all of you.

beats.text: 客官樓上請，新開的香醪。
beats.en: Upstairs, sir. The Fragrant Brew's just been opened.

as.guan: 官人樓上請，閣子還空著。
as.shi: 相公樓上請，憑欄看街景。
as.li: 大哥，櫃上打一角，便宜些。

asEn.guan: Upstairs, sir. A private room is free.
asEn.shi: Upstairs, sir. Sit at the rail and watch the street.
asEn.fu: Wine to take home, madam? At the counter.
asEn.tong: Little one, fetching wine for your family?
asEn.seng: Master, this is a wine house, you know.
asEn.li: Brother, a measure at the counter's cheaper.

beats.en: Drain your cup!
This Fragrant Brew lives up to its name.

beats.text: 京城正店七十二家，數我家熱鬧。
beats.en: Of the capital's seventy-two wine houses, ours is liveliest.
Upstairs is full. Wait just a moment.

beats.text: 來，再敬一杯！這香醪果然好。
beats.en: Come, another cup! This Fragrant Brew is fine indeed.

beats.text: 正店自家釀的，腳店比不得。
beats.en: Brewed in the house. No little tavern can match it.

beats.text: 照這樣喝，今日的酒怕不夠賣。
beats.en: At this rate the wine won't last the day.

beats.text: 天黑了點上燈箱，更好看。
beats.en: After dark we light the lamp-boxes. Even finer.
That red lamp at the door is a gardenia lamp.

beats.text: 掛這燈的，樓上有人陪酒。
beats.en: A house with that lamp has company for drinkers.
Ask no more, sir. Drink, drink.
Lungs and tripe! Sixty full cash a jin!

as.guan: 官人要幾斤？切好送到府上。

asEn.guan: How many jin, sir? Cut and sent to your house.
asEn.fu: Madam, fresh lamb's liver. Cut you a piece?
asEn.jun: Soldier, mutton's the best thing with wine.

beats.en: Lad, cut the good bits for our customer.
Cut thick, or minced fine?
Full strings only. No short strings.

beats.text: 掛著的是羊肺羊腸，下水便宜。
beats.en: Hanging there: lungs and guts. Offal's cheap.

beats.text: 羊肉嘛，一斤要百二十文。
beats.en: Mutton itself? A hundred and twenty cash a jin.

beats.text: 說書的一散場，生意就來了。
beats.en: When the storyteller's done, trade picks up.

beats.text: 掌櫃坐門口，我替他操刀。
beats.en: The owner sits at the door; I mind the knife for him.

beats.text: 這肉鋪，是孫羊正店開的。
beats.en: This shop belongs to the Sun Yang wine house.

beats.text: 城裏處處有肉案，三五人操刀。
beats.en: Every lane has a meat counter, three or five at the knife.

beats.text: 我只坐著收錢，刀是夥計的。
beats.en: I just sit and take the money; the knife is the lad's.
Clear the way! Clear the way!

asEn.guan: Stand back, sir! Army wagon coming through!
asEn.jun: Make way, brother, we're off for the wine!
asEn.tong: Kid, want to get killed? Move!
asEn.fu: Madam, get clear! It can't stop!
asEn.seng: Excuse us, Master, the wagon's fast!
asEn.shi: Sir, don't stand in the middle of the road!
asEn.li: You with the load, keep to the side!

beats.en: Mind the porter!
Whoa, slow down!
Who answers for it if we're late?
We're off to the fire post for the wine.

asEn.guan: Pardon, sir. We're in a hurry to fetch the wine.

beats.text: 節下的酒，營裏等著喝呢。
beats.en: Holiday wine. The barracks are waiting for it.

beats.text: 饞酒饞成這樣，命都不要了。
beats.en: So thirsty for wine they'd risk their necks.
Hear the bell, you give way.
Another one behind! Keep left!

beats.text: 四頭騾子，拉得動一屋子酒。
beats.en: Four mules could pull a houseful of wine.
Don't let him know me.

as.shi: 是同窗……莫叫他瞧見我這身。

asEn.guan: That official again. Cover up, quick.
asEn.shi: A fellow student… don't let him see me like this.

beats.en: Sir, over there…
Hush. Keep walking.
Master's hiding behind his fan again.
My master means no rudeness.

as.guan: 官人莫怪，我家相公不是失禮。

asEn.guan: Don't take offence, sir. My master means no rudeness.

beats.text: 扇子遮臉，是不打招呼的禮數。
beats.en: A fan over the face is the polite way not to greet.
Meet, and it's half a day of pleasantries.
The new faction rules now. Least said, best.
The fan keeps the dust off too, sir.
Come along. Let's not be late.
Here for exam news? Sit and talk.

as.guan: 官人也來打聽今科的消息？
as.shi: 相公是哪一州解送來的？
as.jun: 軍爺，這裏只管舉子的事。
as.li: 大哥，這裏是讀書人的地方。

asEn.guan: You too, sir, asking after this year's exams?
asEn.shi: Which prefecture sent you up, young sir?
asEn.fu: Asking on your husband's behalf, madam?
asEn.tong: Little one, come back when you've studied.
asEn.seng: Master, after an official post too?
asEn.jun: Soldier, we deal only with candidates here.
asEn.li: Brother, this is a place for scholars.

beats.en: Old master, is there hope this time?
Write well and you'll pass.
From your lips!
Once Qingming's past, the exams begin.

beats.text: 京城的客店，都住滿了舉子。
beats.en: The capital's inns are full of candidates.
The papers are in. Now we wait for the day.

beats.text: 莫慌，三年一回，總有出頭日。
beats.en: Easy now. Every third year: your day will come.
Looks like a fortune-teller's stall to me.
Grandpa, what does 'jie' mean?
This 'jie' is the exam hall's word.
Top of the prefecture's list is called the jieyuan.
Policy essays this year, they say.

as.guan: 見過官人。學生進京赴考。
as.seng: 師父好。我們是赴考的舉子。
as.tong: 小哥兒，可知貢院怎麼走？

asEn.guan: My respects, sir. I've come up for the exams.
asEn.shi: Are you here for the exams too, brother?
asEn.seng: Good day, Master. We're candidates for the exams.
asEn.fu: Pardon us, madam. Let us pass.
asEn.tong: Lad, do you know the way to the exam hall?

beats.en: May we pass at the first try.
Your book box, sir.
Hold it carefully. Don't knock it.

beats.text: 你箱裏可還有蘇學士的字？
beats.en: Have you still got any of Su's writing in your box?

beats.text: 噓！元祐諸公的字，如今藏不得了。
beats.en: Hush! The Yuanyou men's writing can't be kept now.

beats.text: 聽說一車車推出城去燒了。
beats.en: They say cartloads went out of town to be burnt.
Such fine brushwork. Such a waste.
Sir, will the inn still have a room?

as.guan: 官人可知哪家客店有空房？

asEn.guan: Sir, do you know an inn with a room free?

beats.en: We'll stay at Wang the Squire's Long-Stay Inn.

beats.text: 樓上那一位，天天讀到半夜。
beats.en: The one upstairs reads till midnight every night.

scenes.title: 方井汲水
scenes.titleEn: Drawing Water at the Square Well

beats.en: You go first. I'll wait.

as.guan: 官人要水？等我打上這一桶。
as.fu: 娘子先打，這井四個人打得。
as.seng: 師父喝口水？剛打上來的。
as.li: 兄弟也來挑水？這邊有空。

asEn.guan: Water, sir? Let me bring up this bucket.
asEn.fu: After you, madam. Four can draw at this well.
asEn.tong: Kid, keep away from the well-mouth!
asEn.li: Here for water too, brother? There's room here.

beats.en: Sweet water, this.
I'm off. They're waiting for water to cook.

beats.text: 井口架成田字，四人一齊打。
beats.en: The mouth's framed in four, so four can draw at once.

beats.text: 井不深，繩子放一截就夠。
beats.en: It's not deep. A short length of rope will do.

beats.text: 京城百萬人，誰家不吃水？
beats.en: A million people in the capital. Who doesn't need water?
This load goes to the east end of the street.
Strong frame. Nobody can fall in.
Qingming's come. The water's warmer.

beats.text: 紙馬、紙錢、紙樓，上墳用的都有。
beats.en: Paper horses, money, houses: all you need for the graves.

as.fu: 娘子，給先人燒一副紙錢？
as.tong: 小哥兒，紙馬碰不得，會破的。

asEn.guan: It's Qingming, sir. Take a set?
asEn.shi: Sir, a set for your family?
asEn.fu: Madam, paper money to burn for your forebears?

beats.en: What fine folding on this paper tower.

beats.text: 城裏城外，今日都上墳去。
beats.en: In town and out, everyone visits the graves today.
What deal are they talking about?

beats.text: 燒了紙馬，先人在那邊也有馬騎。
beats.en: Burn a paper horse, and your forebears have one to ride.

beats.text: 出城上墳，天黑才回得來。
beats.en: Out to the graves, and back only after dark.
I want to ride a paper horse too!
You can't ride this one. It's for burning.
Three days running, people come to buy.

beats.text: 上完墳，就在樹底下吃一頓。
beats.en: After the graves, a meal under the trees.
Those three have been at it for ages.
Look at this one. Good and thick.

as.guan: 官人，這件給府上下人穿正好。
as.seng: 師父也看看？做僧衣也好。
as.li: 大哥，這件耐穿，幹活正好。

asEn.guan: Sir, this would suit a servant of your house.
asEn.seng: Have a look too, Master? It'd make a fine robe.
asEn.li: Brother, this one lasts. Good for work.
asEn.tong: Lad, go and fetch your mother to look.
asEn.jun: Soldier, it'll keep you warm on night watch.

beats.text: 好是好，貧僧沒這許多錢。
beats.en: Fine, but a poor monk hasn't the money.

beats.text: 師父化了半日緣，也該添件衣裳。
beats.en: Half a day begging, Master. Time for a new robe.
Cheaper for you. Call it a good deed.
Second-hand, but washed spotless.
Amitabha. You're kind, sir.

beats.text: 這和尚笑嘻嘻的，倒好說話。
beats.en: A smiling monk. Easy to deal with.

beats.text: 這時節，寺裏放我們出來化緣。
beats.en: This season the temple lets us out to beg alms.

beats.text: 今日街上的和尚，比平日多。
beats.en: More monks on the street today than usual.

beats.text: 貧僧再轉一轉，回頭再來。
beats.en: I'll go round once more and come back.

alts: 話說那赤壁江上，火光沖天——
altsEn: Now on the river at Red Cliff, flames lit the sky…
Then came the sound of a drum…
Meanwhile, the warships of the south…
Patience. Let me tell it in order.
They tell it in more detail in the pleasure grounds.
Well told. A few cash for him.
That part's worth a few cash.
He's at the burning of the ships.

alts: 今日就說到這裏，明日請早。
altsEn: That's all for today. Come early tomorrow.
I want to squeeze in and hear…

alts: 好花苗，栽下去開春就開！
altsEn: Good seedlings! Plant them and they bloom this spring!
They'll take. Plant them and they sprout.

alts: 坐這裏看人，比看戲還好。
altsEn: So many people at the tavern door today.
Sitting here watching folk beats any show.

alts: 清明了，進城的都來喝一盅。
altsEn: Qingming: everyone in town drops in for a cup.
Is that the Sun Yang wine house ahead?
Here we are, here we are.

alts: 這門親事，今日定要說成。

altsEn: Whose household is in the chair?
Slower, the back can't keep up.
The chair behind is a matchmaker too.
This Fragrant Brew is fine indeed!
Good wine, the house's Fragrant Brew!
It's the holiday. Have a few more.
Silver Flask wine: seventy-two cash a measure.
Wine upstairs costs a bit more.
Watching the street from up here is fun.
I'll drink till dark, then go.

alts: 糧袋卸下來，正店要釀酒。
altsEn: These sacks of grain go into the wine house.
Unload the sacks. The house needs them for brewing.

alts: 正店有官許，自家能釀酒。
altsEn: A licensed house brews its own wine.
No wonder it takes so much grain.
Hold it tight. Don't let it wander.
Give it a drink of water.
Paid tax again at the gate.
Taxed several times on the way.

alts: 糧也要納稅，有甚麼法子。
altsEn: Grain pays tax too. What can you do.
Once this cart's unloaded, a rest.
Clear off! Army wagon going for the wine!

alts: 快些，營裏等著節下的酒！
altsEn: Faster, the barracks want their holiday wine!
Get the wine loaded before noon!
So thirsty for wine they'd risk their necks.
Turning like that, there'll be an accident.
The casks are rocking! Slow down!
Where are these two casks going?
Is this the wine house's wine?

alts: 送腳店的，他們向正店打酒。
altsEn: To a small tavern. They buy from the wine house.
Small taverns get their wine from the big house.
I'm old. Can't drive fast any more.
I'm off. They're waiting for water to cook.
This load will last half a day.
Don't spill it on the way.

alts: 紙馬紙錢，上墳用的都有！
altsEn: Paper horses, paper money, all for the graves!
It's Qingming! Take a set of paper horses!
How much is the paper tower?
Cheap. I'll give you a fair price.
That deal in the east of town: settled?
What do you think of that lot of goods?
The broker wants his cut again.
What deal are they talking about?
Don't touch. Tear it and you pay.
More people at the graves than other years.
The graveyards outside town are packed.
That's why the paper horses sell fast.
This stall lives on these few days.
Old master, is there hope this time?
How many will they pass this year?
Places are few. It's down to each of you.
Then I've as good as passed.
You'd better work on your handwriting first.
Have you handed in your papers?
Handed in. Now we wait for news.
A senior from my home town.
Every inn in the capital is full.
At my inn there are four to a room.

alts: 赴考的人，一年比一年多。
altsEn: It's exam time. We squeeze in.
What are these scholars all asking?
Looks like a fortune-teller's stall to me.
Ask all you like. It's down to fate.
When I grow up I'll sit the exams too.
At him, thinking he's passed already.
So many people. We can't move.

alts: 小哥兒，莫站驢屁股後頭。
altsEn: Lad, don't stand behind its rump.
The goods are at the east end. Come and see.
Right there, in the inn at the east end.
Good. We'll talk price once I've seen them.
The price can be talked over.
Round the back of the wine house.
Don't fuss. We'll see at home.
Such a crush. Watch your purse.
Lots of hands in a crowd like this.
Liu's aloeswood and sandalwood are top grade.
The state controls it. Prices won't fall.
Long time no see. Keeping well?
Thanks to you, thanks to you.

alts: 香鋪的人頂帽披背，一看就認得。
altsEn: Incense men wear a cap and cape. You know them at a glance.
That's one of the incense wrappers.

alts: 京城裏，一行有一行的衣裳。
做甚麼的，看衣裳就知道。
altsEn: In the capital every trade has its own dress.
You can tell a man's trade by his clothes.
Make it steady. Don't let the tray tip.
Food sellers keep their trays spotless.

alts: 是說書的，回頭帶你去聽。
altsEn: Hold on tight. Don't fall off.
A storyteller. I'll take you to hear him later.
Carried you all this way. You're getting heavy.
Look at this one, Master. Thick.
I'll let you have this one cheap.

alts: 好是好，貧僧沒這許多錢。
altsEn: Fine, but a poor monk hasn't the money.
Amitabha. Let me look a while.
Has the wine cart gone by?
What's all the fuss out there?
Sit and rest. Have a bowl of something hot.
All right, I'll sit a while.
Can I set my box on it?
To the east end. Your way?
How much this bolt of gauze?
The finest gauze, a fair price.
The Wang shop's silks. You can trust them.
Thanks to you, thanks to you.
Going out of town for the holiday?

alts: 幸會，幸會！今日可有好買賣？
altsEn: Well met! Any good business today?
Let's talk more at the inn some day.
Come for a cup when you're free.
Well now, long time no see!
Did that lot of goods sell?
Another good cut from this one.
What are you selling in the box?
Someone's food boxes. Not for sale.
Go west. Keep out of the market.
So much livelier in town than outside.
Got the pole steady on your shoulder?
That stack of boxes isn't light.
Hold the umbrella up. Keep the rain off them.
Choose first, then we'll talk price.
I'll take this little jar too.
When the storyteller stops, the crowd comes.
Sit high and you see far.
Keep your eyes on the stall.

alts: 刀下利索些，客人等著呢。
羊肝切薄些，客人要下酒。
altsEn: Quick with the knife; customers are waiting.
Slice the lamb liver thin; the customer wants it with wine.
Got it, sliced nice and thin.
Policy essays this year, they say.
A policy essay must go deep.
May we pass at the first try.
I don't know these pieces well yet.

alts: 蘇學士的字，你還留著麼？
altsEn: Do you still keep any of Su's calligraphy?

alts: 噓，元祐諸公的字藏不得了。
小聲些，如今看都看不得。
altsEn: Shh. The Yuanyou men's writing can't be kept now.
Quietly. Now even looking is forbidden.
Shall I put the box here?
This box weighs on the shoulder.
The bundle's heavy. I can't go faster.
Lungs and tripe! Sixty full cash a jin!

guan: How many jin shall I cut, sir?

alts: 紙馬紙錢，上墳用的都有！
altsEn: It's Qingming. Take a set of paper horses?
Paper horses and money, all for the graves!

fu: Madam, a set to burn for your forebears?

altsEn: The Fragrant Brew's just opened. Upstairs!
Sugarcane from the south, very sweet!

alts: 阿彌陀佛，施主結個善緣。
altsEn: Amitabha. Make a good deed, kind sir.

fu: Kind lady, make a good deed.
seng: Brother, which temple are you from?

alts: 好大一擔行李，從哪裏來的？
altsEn: What a load. Where's he come from?
How far has this monk walked?

alts: 腰護繫緊了，車一到就走。
altsEn: Waist guard's tight. We go when the wagon comes.
Why isn't the wagon here yet?
Too noisy down there to read.
Wang the Squire's inn. This is it.
Fierce sun. Shade under the fan.
So much dust on this street.
Catch my breath, then on again.
The load gets heavier every step.
